name: The Woven Chain-Link
summary: A single link of woven wind — one loop of the chains that held the Veiled Sea's hurricanes for a century after the Bound Storms. It washed ashore near Storm-Bound waters after 1,400 years, still taut, still humming faintly against anyone who grips it. Cutting it would free something somewhere; the link is the only physical proof that weather was ever merchandise.
origin: ~700 CoW — the Bound Storms' chaining relay; lost when the chains were quietly unbound ~730 CoW
current_whereabouts: In the keeping of the Elder Wave's successor at the last tide-moot — held in a barrel of the salt water it was sworn beside.
properties: Taut without anchor: no force tested has slackened it
Hums against the palm in rising wind anywhere on the continent — a storm-warning older than storms
Cutting it is theoretically possible with signed First Forge steel; what happens afterward is not covered by any saga
keepers: The Storm-Bound hold it as evidence and penance; their elders forbid studying it further, which younger members ignore.
value_or_danger: To scholars: proof of the Concord's greatest working. To the desperate: a weapon that is also a promise of catastrophe.
adventure_hooks: A Shard Cities buyer offers a fortune for the link 'for study'; the young Storm-Bound who sold access has vanished.
Players are asked to carry the link to Hallord's sealed shaft — the two hum in harmony, and someone must learn why.
During transport the link goes slack for one full day. The sea was calm everywhere, worldwide. Nobody reported it but the players noticed.
